title: Noxious Spore Grenade
summary: Throw for a Poison blast and a lingering, flammable cloud.

fields.Throw: Action, single use, 60 ft range. Make a spell attack for the separate 2d4 + 1 Poison blast. Creates a 7 ft radius Noxious Fumes cloud for 3 turns.
fields.Noxious Fumes: Entering or starting a turn in the cloud can apply Noxious Fumes while inside. DC 15 Constitution save against 2d4 Poison, half damage on a success. Movement in the fumes can retrigger this damage. The condition also deals 1d4 Poison per turn, which the item notes report does not apply on the first turn.
fields.Flammable: Fire can detonate the cloud and leave burning ground.
fields.Alchemy: Extract three Poison Spores into Sublimate of Poison Spores. Add any Ashes to craft one grenade.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
